name: Paphos
description: On Cyprus's southwest coast, Paphos preserves ruins from the ancient city that grew around the legendary birthplace of Aphrodite, where Mycenaeans built a temple to her in the 12th century B.C. Visitors can wander through the remains of villas, theatres, fortresses and tombs. The star attraction is the floor mosaics of Nea Paphos, counted among the finest in the world.
